name: Tufted Duck
summary: This painting of a tufted duck is an example of a type of picture mass-produced in China for European visitors. It was made in Canton (Guangzhou) in southern China. In the 18th century the city became the principal, and later the only, trading port at which Europeans were permitted to buy Chinese go
